description: Use of resources is not monitored and adjusted with projections for future capacity requirements.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not monitor resource utilization (CPU, memory, storage, network bandwidth) or plan for future capacity needs, risking performance degradation or system unavailability.

metadata.detection_notes: Review capacity monitoring tools, resource utilization metrics, capacity planning processes, growth projections, performance baselines, and alerting mechanisms for capacity thresholds.
